rationale: r2gaussian-claude-agentic: val_n=15, gs_n_gaussians=512, gs_n_iter=150, gs_lr_pos=0.005, gs_lr_scale=0.01, gs_lr_amp=0.01, gs_lr_rot=0.01, gs_amp_init=0.01, gs_scale_init=0.04, gs_tv_weight=0.0001, gs_n_clip=0.05, gs_init_from_fbp=False, gs_render=raster, gs_ssim_weight=0.0, seed=42, train_n=0, rationale=iter-1 ONBOARDING r2gaussian (R2-Gaussian-lite: N anisotropic 2D Gaussians rasterized to a mu-image, forward-projected via PYRO-NN, MSE+TV+neg vs the 128-view noisy sino, per-scene) on the re-split Breast-CT (train 3600 / val 200 / test 200, seed 20260703). REDUCED val_n=15 (NOT 200) because r2gaussian is a HEAVY per-scene fit (timing probe: 273 ms/Adam-step at 512 Gaussians/128-view/512^2 -> ~41 s/scene at gs_n_iter=150); 15 scenes x 41 s = ~615 s (~10 min) fits the HARD 20-min train+score budget with all 15 scenes completing (gs_outer_wall_s=1080 self-truncate never fires). val_n=15 is held CONSTANT across all 20 iters. SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: none (first iter this slug); documented ceiling (docs/findings.md 2026-06-03): R2-Gaussian is STRUCTURALLY bounded on dense 128-view breast -> hr=0 confirmed at gs_n_iter 300->40k and with FBP warm-start; the anisotropic-Gaussian basis is too coarse for densely-distributed soft tissue at 512^2/128-view, and the 128-view FBP baseline is already very strong (SSIM ~0.957). (2) FAILURE MODE: N/A onboarding; goal = does r2gaussian run on the new breast val=15 split under the HARD 20-min budget, and does it clear the 128-view sparse-FBP baseline (hr>0)? Expect hr=0 per the documented ceiling. (3) ONE KNOB: N/A baseline (mirrors the Mayo iter-1 knobs adapted to breast: 512 Gaussians / 150 steps / default LRs). (4) HYPOTHESIS: cold-init 512-Gaussian / 150-step per-scene fit lands BELOW the 128-view FBP baseline on RMSE -> hr=0, because the Gaussian basis is too sparse for dense breast soft tissue (findings 2026-06-03). If hr>0, the ceiling is refuted and I re-map; if hr=0 at SSIM ~0.88-0.94 (per prior breast R2-G), the documented ceiling reproduces on the new split. (5) BUDGET: 15 scenes x ~41 s = ~615 s + FBP-load + scoring + figure << 1200 s HARD < 1800 s (30-min) SLURM wall; gs_outer_wall_s=1080 self-truncates before the SLURM kill. (6) STRICT SERIAL, one job at a time; loop continues, iter-2 self-dispatched on the per-JOBID DONE sentinel. Reserved levers for iters 2-N: gs_n_iter, gs_n_gaussians, gs_init_from_fbp, gs_ssim_weight, gs_lr_*.
